title_o: Rapid onset of pathological gambling in machine gamblers

replications.journal: eCOMMUNITY: International Journal of Mental Health & Addiction
replications.quote: the mean latency of PG onset in the 62 participants who were traditional gamblers at the time of onset was significantly longer than that of the 118 participants who were machine gamblers (3.89 vs. 1.09 years; t = 3.85, p < .001).
